meaning:
δέσμη (Rec. δεσμή), -ης, ἡ
(δέω), [in LXX for אֲגֻדָּה, Exo.12:22 * ;]
a bundle: δήσατε αὐτὰ εἰς δέσμας (D, Orig., omit εἰς, and Blass thinks original reading, δέσμας δέσμας; see Deiss., LAE, 125.4), Mat.13:30.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn…
